fragments.text: On July 10, 2026, the Group entered into its first senior secured debt facility in an aggregate principal amount of approximately $775.
Senior secured debt facility
The facility bears interest at SOFR plus 2.50% and matures on October 31, 2030.
The facility is collateralized by deployed GPU infrastructure and by contracted cash flows arising under a customer agreement with an investment-grade counterparty.

items.comment: Subsequent-event note discloses the July 10, 2026 senior secured facility at approximately $775 million.

fragments.text: Remaining performance obligations ("RPO") represent the transaction price allocated to performance obligations that are unsatisfied or partially unsatisfied as of the end of the reporting period.

As of June 30, 2026, the amount of unsatisfied RPO was $37,490.6, of which 36% is expected to be recognized as revenue during the 24 months ending June 30, 2028, 40% between months 25 and 48, and the remainder recognized thereafter.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Large contracted backlog supports AI infrastructure buildout and financing.

fragments.text: The Group has contractual obligations arising from contracts with remaining terms greater than one year, primarily consisting of energy and power supply agreements, related to the co-location arrangements and the development of greenfield data center facilities.

As of June 30, 2026, expected future fixed or minimum guaranteed commitments under these agreements amounted to $81.7 in 2026, $541.8 in 2027, $542.0 in 2028, $540.5 in 2029, $535.8 in 2030, and $3,082.3 thereafter.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Long-term power commitments support AI data centers and add fixed obligations.

fragments.text: At-the-market equity program

During the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Company sold 12,729,493 Class A shares under the ATM program at a weighted-average price of $223.60 per share before issuance costs. Net proceeds accounted for $2,811.1 after deducting sales agents' commissions and offering costs.
As of June 30, 2026, 12,270,507 Class A shares remained available for offer and sale under the ATM program.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Equity funding supports AI cloud infrastructure expansion.
